Question: Is there any Hadith where it is proven to raise hands in the third raka'at of Witr salat and recite the Du'a-e-Qunut? Please give the Hadith with its translation and the name of the Hadith book with the name of the chapter [where this Hadith is found] and also the number of the Hadith. Answer ID: 1189 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 509/497=N) عن الأسود عن عبد اللہ انہ کان یقرأ فی آخر رکعۃ من الوتر قل ھو اللہ احد ثم یرفع یدیہ و یقنت قبل الرکعۃ (اخرجہ البخاری فی جزء رفع الیدین) Aswad narrated from Abdullah that the Prophet ( Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) used to recite Surah Ikhlas in last rakat of witr , then he used to raise his hands and recite qunoot before ruku . (Bukhari, Juzu Raf-il-Yadain) واثر ابراھیم النخعی بسند صحیح عند الطحاوی: ترفع الأیدی فی سبع مواطن؛ فی افتتاح الصلاۃ و فی التکبیر للقنوت فی الوتر الخ (اعلاء السنن؛ 6/101، ط باکستان) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
